product_metadata.title: SUPERIOR 100% Cotton 500 GSM 2 Piece Bath Towel Set Wisteria Jacquard Dobby Border, Quick Dry Bohemian Floral Farmhouse, Decorative Oversized Plush Hotel Luxury, Bath Towels, Garnet
features: OPULENT COMFORT: Each towel brings sophistication and comfort to any bathroom, guest bathroom, or master bath space
QUALITY CONSTRUCTION: High-quality Cotton construction is very absorbent to get you dry quickly; set includes 2 bath towels; OEKO-TEX Certified to meet environmental and safety standards.
SUPER SOFTNESS: Towel set includes an ultra-soft and plush design with a unique floral dobby border; each towel brings sophistication to any bathroom, guest bathroom, or master bath space

GORGEOUS STYLE and APPEALING COLORS: Available in a delightful range of colors; Black, Frappe, Grey, Garnet, Ivory, Mandarin, Navy Blue, Turquoise, Waterfall, White; perfect for any master bath, powder room, dorm room or guest bathroom

CARE LABEL: These beautiful towels are easily machine washable in warm water with like colors. For drying, tumble dry low and remove them promptly from dryer. Always follow care label instructions for best results. Avoid using chlorine bleach, fabric softeners and dryer sheets, as they may decrease absorbency.
description: Give your bathroom an elegant transformation with the Superior Cotton 2 Piece Towel Set. Crafted from a premium Cotton construction for comfort and durability, each towel provides a versatile absorption, perfect for the shower, bath or beach. The pattern is a unique solid color towel with a coordinating floral jacquard border design that will match with any Traditional, Vintage, Bohemian, or Modern space.
